# Adopt one bounded decision site

Read [the short guide](../../../docs/decision-sites.md), the target project's intent,
and the [project survey](../../../docs/assessments/2026-10-23-decision-sites.md) when its
named source seam applies. Existing judgments or deferred admission are not blank slates.
Keep mutations within the requested project. This skill grants no provider spending,
private-data disclosure, global setup or consumer migration permission.

- Identify one semantic residue, one authoritative input scope and the deterministic
  baseline. Compute exact lookups, tests, permission, dates/counts and required coverage.
  If computation solves the task, record that decision and stop model adoption.
- Specify a predicate, choice or score, its unknown/held path, the consequence of each
  mistake, owner, fallback, eligible provider/model and a measurable keep/revise/stop bar.
  Use existing `decision.Decider` adapters; a model result cannot create authority.
- For text-only string-choice packs, use [decision-lab's complete fixtures](../../../cmd/decision-lab/README.md)
  to prepare bound inputs, check captured port responses, and study independent labels.
  Other shapes need their existing adapter conformance and domain-specific oracle;
  do not silently coerce them into the lab's choice study.
- Keep the expected case/question set separate from captured results. Retain cohort,
  input, policy, provider/resolved-model identities and label provenance. Check refusal,
  omission, malformed response, changed model/context and adversarial missing information.
  Audit false favorable answers by predicted class. Answer-cache reuse adds no fresh N.
- Default to provider-none/replay and a shadow observation. An available key is not
  consent. The target application enforces permission, pre-dispatch budgets, freshness,
  source policy and effect boundaries. Live calls need existing explicit authority.
  Report synthetic statistics as synthetic; no automatic promotion or universal threshold.

Deliver the exact site/pack and artifact identities, runnable offline command, planted
negative result, scope/fallback and the next measurement needed for adoption. Distinguish
implementation, integration, actual consumer adoption and measured benefit. Preserve an
existing successful path until its replacement meets the receiver's acceptance criteria.
